Quotes must avoid the "2" footnote mark, so use "Outpatient X-rays" and "$25 copay" separately? That doesn't work, because "$25 copay" repeats on the page (outpatient individual therapy is on page 4, not page 3). On page 3, "$25 copay" appears only once. "Outpatient X-rays" also appears only once on page 3. So two separate quotes pass.

```json
[{"plan_id": "H3805-040-0", "benefit": "imaging.xray", "setting": "any", "network": "in", "covered_by": "medicare", "cost_kind": "copay", "amount": "$25", "page": 3, "quotes": ["Outpatient X-rays", "$25 copay"]}]
```
